about: Guest information for the free hotel list cards of the boards (js/hotel-list-card.js) and the full list in the phone app (app.html). Facts only: name, street address, phone, website, the logo where an official one reads on the cream column. No prices, no offers. Every field keeps the source it was read from and whether it was verified.
runtime: fids-current/data/hotels/yqm.json is made from this file by scripts/hotels/build-runtime.js: only the hotels that are listed and only the fields the cards and the phone app read. Edit this file, then run the script; tests/hotel-list-cards.test.js holds the two to agree.

rules.areas: downtown = within about 2 km of the centre point; airport = within about 5 km of the airport point; resort = a destination resort (resort true) more than 30 km from both points, listed with its drive distance (no tolerance); nearby = the rest within about 30 km of either point. Each about-limit has a 10 % tolerance; downtown is tested first, then airport.
rules.listed: listed false = held back (the reason is given). A listed hotel is shown only while its season is open (season.year_round, or a season.open range that holds the date at the airport).
rules.shuttle: shuttle.mark true only where the shuttle is verified on the hotel's or the airport's own page.
rules.logo: logo.file is loaded through , never inlined; opaque = the file has its own light ground (shown with a multiply blend on the cream column so the box does not show).
rules.logo_fill: logo.fill true = a stacked lockup whose words are small at the common logo height (62 px at 1680x1050): it may take the whole cell of the cream column, the width of the column and the height of its line. The file is shown as it is.

notes.verified_definition: verified true = read directly on 2026-11-16 (unless a date says otherwise) on the hotel's own site, its brand property page, the official destination listing or the airport's own page; or OpenStreetMap read directly plus one agreeing independent source. Facts confirmed directly say so. verified false = one weaker source, a search-index quote, or sources that disagree: the note says which.
notes.postal_note: The Destination Moncton-Dieppe listing printed a wrong postal code for 7 of the 22 hotels where a second source exists (Residence Inn by Marriott Moncton (listing E1C 0C5, right E1C 0M6); Rodd Moncton (listing E1C 1N6, right E1C 1B9); Château Moncton, Trademark Collection by Wyndham (listing E1C 1N6, right E1C 1B9); Travelodge Suites by Wyndham Moncton (listing E1G 6H5, right E1G 2J5); Quality Inn Magnetic Hill (listing E1G 6B1, right E1G 1B4); Amsterdam Inn & Suites Moncton (listing E1G 6B1, right E1G 1B4); Hotel Moncton (listing E1G 0J3, right E1G 2W5)), so a postal code resting on that listing alone is marked verified false.
notes.shuttle_note: shuttle.value: true / false / null (unknown). true only where the hotel or the airport says so in a page read directly. card_mark true = show the "Airport shuttle | Navette aéroport" mark (legend strings live in board-strings). HotelPlanner prints a default "Sorry, no airport shuttle available" line on every page; only its hotel-supplied text is quoted. Entries dated 2026-11-11 come from the earlier round and were not re-read (no shuttle claim rests on them).
notes.season_note: season.open_months lists the months open (1-12); seasonal true would mean it closes part of the year; closed_now is judged for 2026-11-16.
sources: Hotels' own sites and Wyndham property pages (read directly)
Destination Moncton-Dieppe listings, destinationmonctondieppe.ca (official destination body; each listing page read directly)
Greater Moncton Roméo LeBlanc International Airport: Nearby Hotels and Transportation pages, cyqm.ca
OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API (ODbL): credit "© OpenStreetMap contributors"
HotelPlanner hotel-supplied text and travel directories, for shuttle research only (cached 2026-11-11)
OSRM demo router (road distance check for The Algonquin)

unverified: Quality Inn Airport shuttle: directories only (Cvent, HotelsCombined, Travelocity); the hotel and the airport do not say so in anything readable. Phone (506) 858-8880. card_mark is false until confirmed.
Wingate by Wyndham Dieppe Moncton shuttle: hotel text on HotelPlanner says a free shuttle 7 am to 11 pm; the Wyndham page and the airport page do not. Phone (506) 830-8330.
Wild Rose Inn shuttle: real (own site) but only with the Stay, Park & Fly package; open decision whether that earns the mark (card_mark false for now).

Brand pages refuse automated readers (Marriott, Hilton, IHG, Hyatt, Choice, Best Western all answered 403 on 2026-11-16): those 15 hotels rest on the destination listing, the airport page and OpenStreetMap, and their website URLs are taken from the listing, not opened.

Postal codes on one source only (destination listing): Holiday Inn Express & Suites Dieppe Airport E1A 7E6, Fairfield Inn & Suites Moncton E1A 7S4, Hilton Garden Inn E1C 5N2. Postal codes are not shown on the cards.
Best Western Plus Moncton website: property code 64007 comes from a search index; the listing only links the bestwestern.com home page.

Hôtel Shediac: the only number on its site is the toll-free (855) 836-6100; OpenStreetMap has a local (506) 532-6100. It states no winter closure; Shediac is a summer town, so a call would settle the season.
Season: only Wild Rose Inn and The Algonquin state "year round" on their own sites; every other entry is a year-round city hotel with no closure stated (season.verified false, closed_now false).

Downtown by the straight-line rule but not in the downtown core: Best Western Plus (1.8 km), Coastal Inn and Comfort Inn East (1.9 km) sit by Champlain Place / Lewisville Road. Open decision: Nearby may suit them better.
Area borderline: Wingate Dieppe is 5.4 km from the airport point and 2.6 km from the centre: Airport under the 10 % tolerance.

Kept but motel-like: Coastal Inn Moncton/Dieppe (OpenStreetMap tags it motel; the chain calls it a hotel) and Thriftlodge by Wyndham (economy brand, former Howard Johnson): either may be dropped under the motel rule.
Casino New Brunswick: whether a casino hotel belongs on a guest-information card is an open decision; it is included for now.
St. James’ Gate phone: its own site labels (506) 388-4283 as the restaurant line (extension 1). Kept on the card (verified false) until the number to call for a room is confirmed.
Logos: the logo field of each hotel (logos/hotels/list/sources.json).
